# Den lilla draken

> Original Swedish illustrated bedtime stories for ages 0–3.

## First story

- [Den lilla draken och den borttappade glöden](index.html): A gentle Swedish bedtime story about an unnamed child, the talkative little dragon, and a lost glow that finds its way home.

## Project references

- [Lore bible](LORE.md): World, narrative promises, and visual direction.
- [Illustration provenance](ASSET-PROVENANCE.md): Original-image sourcing for every illustration.
- [Svenska sagostunder skill](skills/svenska-sagostunder/SKILL.md): Reusable instructions for warm Swedish bedtime stories.
